name: [Let's Do Addon] Apple Wood Rebarked
description:
Do you miss the good, old Apple Wood add-on? Enjoy the rework of Apple Wood with new features, improvements and extended compatibility!

Caution: This mod is my modding playground to learn and have fun. Things may be added and removed during development at any time.

Big thanks to:
- Satisfy for the work on the [Let's Do] series
- Berksire for creating the original Apple Wood add-on
- Chaperie for putting up with my stupid questions about modding
- YOU for playing!
